Who We Are

USC ASA is USC's home for Armenian culture, heritage, and community. We run cultural, professional, and social programming year-round, from our annual Big Bear retreat to Armenian History Month, for a growing community of students at USC. We collaborate with a multitude of other clubs, both on and off campus, to bring even more to our members. We hope to see you soon at one of our events, where you can make some lifelong friends and memories.
